# Test-only dependencies (ADR-0035 D4 (a)): the ONE list of import-path prefixes
# that no production binary (cmd/*) may reach, however indirectly.
#
# Single source. Three consumers read this file and nothing else:
#   - internal/apispec/e2e_boundary_test.go: the static import-closure check
#     (V1) and its planted violations.
#   - internal/apispec/testonly_deps_test.go: the real-graph check (V2: `go list
#     -deps ./cmd/...` has none of these), the stale-entry check (an entry that
#     is in neither go.mod nor the module is red) and the completeness check
#     (every module that only a test reaches must be listed here).
#   - scripts/check-test-only-vuln.sh: the CI govulncheck step that scans exactly
#     these modules (ADR-0035 V5).
#
# Format: one import-path prefix per line; `#` starts a comment. A prefix matches
# itself and everything below it (`github.com/dop251/goja` matches
# `github.com/dop251/goja/parser`, not `github.com/dop251/gojax`); a trailing `/`
# is ignored. A module-internal prefix is written in full. An external entry names
# the MODULE (the path in go.mod), not its org: the completeness check counts a
# module as covered only by an entry that is the module or lies under it.
#
# Adding a NEW DIRECT test-only dependency needs its own ADR until workspace #77 is
# decided (ORGANIZATION.md section 8 criterion 4; ADR-0035 「基準④との関係」);
# the completeness check is red until the module is listed here. A transitive
# dependency that an already approved one gained in an update may, provisionally,
# be added here with the D4 table in the PR body (VP ruling). Removing the last
# user of one means deleting its line (the stale-entry check is red until you do).

# chromedp + cdproto: the browser E2E harness (ADR-0031), `make e2e`, build tag e2e.
github.com/chromedp/chromedp
github.com/chromedp/cdproto
# ...and chromedp's own JSON dependency (reached only with -tags e2e).
github.com/go-json-experiment/json

# goja: the pure-Go JS engine the portal's display-name test runs the form's JS
# in (ADR-0035, app#343). The next three are goja's transitive dependencies.
github.com/dop251/goja
github.com/dlclark/regexp2/v2
github.com/go-sourcemap/sourcemap
github.com/google/pprof

# Reached only by test packages (prometheus/testutil's diff).
github.com/kylelemons/godebug

# Test-only packages of this module: no cmd/* binary may link them (V1 / V2 look
# at all of cmd/*; internal/apispec/dependency_boundary_test.go also names the
# two parity packages on its own).
github.com/Qfour/falco-ctf-app/internal/e2e
github.com/Qfour/falco-ctf-app/internal/apispec/specparity
github.com/Qfour/falco-ctf-app/internal/apispec/ingressparity
